title: Riders on a Hit

Four kinds (adds dice, asks for a save, changes the damage, words), each with its cost; No Name's Stunning Strike and Empowered Strikes and Big C's Divine Smite and Savage Attacker playable. Two choices: when the cost is spent, and where a save's DC goes.

title: Roll Data Review
what: Brett: build roll data from the whole 2024 PHB and DMG, after a devil's-advocate look at its structure. Where roll data lives today (seven places, four ways to say something is added to a roll), what breaks at the scale of two books, the case against changing it, and the recommendation: one effect shape (rolls and adds) in a file per book, when it applies as data, scaling as data, a schema and a coverage report over the books.

title: askdnd Outside Review
what: An outside chat's code review of askdnd and the plan for standardizing rolls: findings on security headers, access checks, double submits, hidden entries, the roll data's coverage of the PHB, design and phones; each checked against the code and history, with what Brett chose to fix now, put on the roadmap or leave.
